name: safe-rm-implementation
details: Transform rip2 into safe-rm: a drop-in replacement for rm where permanent deletion requires root. Core safety invariant: non-root users can NEVER permanently delete files via rm.

tasks.name: Phase 1: Safety Foundation
tasks.details: Gate permanent deletion with root-only checks. This MUST be completed first before any other changes.

sub_tasks.name: Add dependencies
sub_tasks.details: Add libc = "0.2" under [target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies] and dirs = "5" to Cargo.toml

sub_tasks.name: Create safety.rs
sub_tasks.details:
New module src/safety.rs with:
- is_root() using libc::geteuid() == 0
- require_root_for_permanent_deletion() returning Error for non-root
- RootChecker trait for testability

sub_tasks.name: Gate decompose
sub_tasks.details: Add root check at lib.rs L59-63 before fs::remove_dir_all(graveyard)

sub_tasks.name: Gate in-graveyard delete
sub_tasks.details: Add root check at lib.rs L186-212 before fs::remove_dir_all/remove_file

sub_tasks.name: Write safety tests
sub_tasks.details:
Tests with MockRootChecker:
- decompose as non-root → Error
- decompose as root → Success
- in-graveyard delete as non-root → Error
- in-graveyard delete as root → Success

sub_tasks.name: Modify get_graveyard()
sub_tasks.details: lib.rs L573-591: Replace env::temp_dir() fallback with dirs::home_dir().join(".graveyard")

sub_tasks.name: Update existing tests
sub_tasks.details: Tests expecting /tmp graveyard need updating for new ~/.graveyard default

tasks.name: Phase 3: Mode Detection
tasks.details: Add dual-mode CLI support: rip mode vs rm mode based on binary name

sub_tasks.name: Add mode detection
sub_tasks.details: main.rs: ExecutionMode enum, detect_mode() checking argv[0] and RIP_MODE env

sub_tasks.name: Update main.rs dispatch
sub_tasks.details: Separate run_rip_mode() and run_rm_mode() functions

sub_tasks.name: Write mode detection tests
sub_tasks.details: Test argv[0]="rm" → Rm mode, argv[0]="rip" → Rip mode, RIP_MODE override

tasks.name: Phase 4: rm Mode Implementation
tasks.details: Full rm-compatible behavior with all supported flags

sub_tasks.name: Split args.rs into module
sub_tasks.details: Create src/args/mod.rs (ExecutionMode, re-exports), rip.rs (current Args renamed to RipArgs), rm.rs (new RmArgs)

sub_tasks.name: Create RmArgs struct
sub_tasks.details: src/args/rm.rs: -f, -r/-R, -d, -v, --preserve-root, --no-preserve-root, --one-file-system

sub_tasks.name: rm error format
sub_tasks.details: GNU rm format: "rm: cannot remove 'file': Reason"

sub_tasks.name: Force mode semantics
sub_tasks.details: rm -f nonexistent → exit 0; rm nonexistent → exit 1

sub_tasks.name: Directory handling
sub_tasks.details: rm dir → "Is a directory"; rm -r dir → graveyard; rm -d empty → graveyard

sub_tasks.name: Verbose output
sub_tasks.details: GNU format: removed 'filename'

sub_tasks.name: Preserve-root protection
sub_tasks.details: Block rm -rf / by default; --no-preserve-root for root only

sub_tasks.name: Home depth protection
sub_tasks.details: Block depth ≤ 2: ~/Desktop; Allow depth > 2: ~/Desktop/project; Override: --yes-i-am-100-percent-certain

sub_tasks.name: Write rm mode tests
sub_tasks.details: Test all flag combinations, error format, exit codes

sub_tasks.name: Remove Windows cfg blocks
sub_tasks.details: Remove #[cfg(target_os = "windows")] blocks from lib.rs and util.rs

sub_tasks.name: Update Cargo.toml
sub_tasks.details: Remove Windows dependencies if any

tasks.name: Phase 6: Testing & Documentation
tasks.details: Comprehensive test coverage and updated documentation

sub_tasks.name: Adversarial safety tests
sub_tasks.details: Test that corrupted safety code causes test failures (e/test methodology)

sub_tasks.name: Edge case tests
sub_tasks.details: Symlinks to root, path traversal, non-standard home directories

sub_tasks.name: Update README
sub_tasks.details: Document safe-rm vision, usage, deployment (dpkg-divert)

sub_tasks.name: Migration guide
sub_tasks.details: Document migration from rip2 to safe-rm, graveyard location change
